message: You know that one friend who gets a little too worked up at the slightest hint of smoke? I remember cooking dinner one night, and just as I was about to pull the pizza out of the oven, my friend burst in, eyes wide, convinced we were moments away from calamity. Turns out, she just saw a bit of steam. It got me thinking about how important it is to have a clear escape plan and functioning smoke alarms—just in case. Ever had a similar moment with friends or family? What’s your go-to kitchen safety tip?
